taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Full taxonomy 0.6.7 review retains unclassified status. FC-000044 Primary Evidence Accessibility requires an authoritative artefact, authorised reviewer, material review question and blocked direct inspection in that context; an unavailable download endpoint alone does not prove those conditions. FC-000024 Audit-Trail Reconstructability requires inadequate logs for reconstructing a material event, not merely a temporarily unavailable retrieval endpoint. FC-000037 Control Availability Determination requires an uncertainty about a defined control before a decision. No such additional occurrence facts are established.

classification_review_provenance.authority_boundary: FC-000044, FC-000024 and FC-000037 tested; none accepted. Compliance-log endpoint interruption is observed, but reviewer, artefact, review question and loss of log integrity are not. No compliance breach inferred.

assessment_boundaries: This metadata pass does not retroactively claim direct inspection of every historical primary source.
Incident admission does not determine legal liability or establish every disputed claim as final fact.
vigil_assessment.factual_basis: OpenAI’s official status page names the affected functions, records ongoing issues on 29 June and marks resolution on 11 July. The independent mirror reports a narrower measured timeline, but both support an interruption lasting well over 24 hours. The status notice says the log download endpoint did not work; it does not show whether the underlying logs were captured, preserved, accessible through other routes or needed for a specified authorised review. A data breach or regulatory failure is not established.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: This occurrence establishes prolonged unavailability of several FedRAMP workspace features, including a compliance-log download route. It creates a plausible evidence-access concern, but the record does not establish the reviewer, required artefact and material review question needed to diagnose a primary-evidence-access failure. The operational incident and its potential governance consequence remain distinct.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: Access to compliance logs and workspace analytics can be important to oversight even when core conversational service is running. The governance question is whether a named reviewer lacked necessary authoritative evidence at a consequential review point, which a general status notice alone does not answer.
